name: Kraken
languages: understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

legendary.name: Tentacle Attack or Fling
legendary.desc: The kraken makes one tentacle attack or uses its Fling.

legendary.name: Lightning Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.desc: The kraken uses Lightning Storm.

legendary.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.desc: While underwater, the kraken expels an ink cloud in a 60-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than the kraken. Each creature other than the kraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the kraken's next turn.

name: Lich
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

legendary.name: Cantrip
legendary.desc: The lich casts a cantrip.

legendary.name: Paralyzing Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.desc: The lich uses its Paralyzing Touch.

legendary.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.desc: The lich fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the lich's gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.desc: Each living creature within 20 feet of the lich must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 21 (6d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Mummy Lord
languages: the languages it knew in life

legendary.name: Attack
legendary.desc: The mummy lord makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

legendary.name: Blinding Dust
legendary.desc: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around the mummy lord. Each creature within 5 feet of the mummy lord must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.desc: The mummy lord utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the mummy lord that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

legendary.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.desc: The mummy lord magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of the mummy lord, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

legendary.name: Whirlwind of Sand (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.desc: The mummy lord magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the mummy lord is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by the mummy lord remain in its possession.
